description:

The Philadelphia Eagles host the Carolina Panthers in NFL Week 6 at Lincoln Financial Field. Philadelphia (2-3) will be without quarterback Jalen Hurts due to injury, while Carolina (2-2) counts on Bryce Young and his 1,268 passing yards.
